column1: # ZAP Rules — suppress false positives for EcomShop
# Format: ALERT_ID  ACTION  PARAMETER  EVIDENCE
#   Actions: IGNORE, WARN, FAIL
#   Use IGNORE only for confirmed false positives.
#   Leave legitimate findings as WARN or FAIL.
# Rule IDs: https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/alerts/
# ── Informational / low-risk (set to WARN so they appear but don't fail CI) ──
# 10015 – Incomplete or No Cache-control Header (Next.js sets its own)
# 10016 – Web Browser XSS Protection Not Enabled
# We set X-XSS-Protection in nginx but ZAP still warns; WARN rather than FAIL
# 10021 – X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing (nginx sets nosniff; false positive)
# 10036 – Server Leaks Version Information via Server HTTP Response Header Field
# nginx/alpine version string — acceptable in dev
# 10055 – CSP Not Set (we don't set a full CSP yet — listed in production checklist)
# 10096 – Timestamp Disclosure — Unix (JWT iat/exp fields are intentional)
# 10110 – Dangerous JS Functions — eval() in Next.js build output (framework code)
# ── Medium risk (WARN — investigate but don't block CI) ──
# 40012 – Cross Site Scripting (Reflected) — test carefully before ignoring
# 40014 – Cross Site Scripting (Persistent) — review ZAP report manually
# ── High risk (FAIL — must be fixed before merge) ──
# 40018 – SQL Injection — never ignore
# 40019 – SQL Injection (MySQL) — never ignore
# 90022 – Application Error Disclosure — stack traces leaking to client
# 10054 – Cookie Without SameSite Attribute — our JWT cookies set samesite=strict
# 10202 – Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens (only FAIL for form submissions)
